description_excerpt: Job Description The Role As a Business Analyst, you will collaborate with our clients and delivery teams to discover and define requirements, form a vision, and successfully delivery solutions to end users. Key Responsibilities • Work closely with stakeholders and users to acquire insights of the business regarding to objectives, risks with complete understanding of their expectation and demands • Evaluate business processes, anticipate requirements, uncover areas for prospective improvements, and consult the most possible solutions • Consolidate, analyze, elaborate, translate requirements…
